items.source:
Set whether to ignore a nested path, if any.
Default is to not ignore.
items.translation: 设置是否忽略嵌套路径（如果有）。默认行为是不忽略。

items.source: The Errors object that has been bound using this tag is exposed to collaborating tags, as well as the bean property that this errors object applies to. Nested tags such as the TransformTag can access those exposed properties.
items.translation: 使用此标签绑定的 `Errors` 对象已暴露给协作标签以及该错误对象所应用的 Bean 属性。诸如 `TransformTag` 之类的嵌套标签可以访问这些已暴露的属性。

items.source:
Can be used to bind to any bean or bean property in the model.
The specified path determines whether the tag exposes the status of the
bean itself (showing object-level errors), a specific bean property
(showing field errors), or a matching set of bean properties
(showing all corresponding field errors).
items.translation: 可用于绑定到模型中的任何 Bean 或 Bean 属性。指定的路径决定该标签是暴露 Bean 本身的状态（显示对象级错误）、特定的 Bean 属性（显示字段错误），还是匹配的 Bean 属性集（显示所有相应的字段错误）。

items.source:
Set HTML escaping for this tag, as boolean value. Overrides the default
HTML escaping setting for the current page.
items.translation: 为此标签设置 HTML 转义，值为布尔类型。覆盖当前页面的默认 HTML 转义设置。

items.source:
The path to the bean or bean property to bind status information for.
For instance account.name, company.address.zipCode or just employee. The status
object will exported to the page scope, specifically for this bean or bean
property
items.translation: 用于绑定状态信息的 Bean 或 Bean 属性的路径。例如 account.name、company.address.zipCode 或仅仅是 employee。该状态对象将导出到页面作用域，专门针对此 Bean 或 Bean 属性。

items.source: Retrieve the property that this tag is currently bound to, or null if bound to an object rather than a specific property. Intended for cooperating nesting tags.
items.translation: 获取此标签当前绑定的属性，或者如果绑定到对象而非特定属性，则为 `null`。旨在用于协同嵌套标签。

items.source: Name of the exposed variable within the scope of this tag: "status".
items.translation: 此标签作用域内暴露的变量名称："status"。

items.source: Called by doStartTag to perform the actual work.
items.translation: 由 doStartTag 调用以执行实际工作。

items.source: Return the path that this tag applies to.
items.translation: 返回该标签适用的路径。

items.source: Return whether to ignore a nested path, if any.
items.translation: 返回是否忽略嵌套路径（如果有）。

items.source:
Set the path that this tag should apply. Can be a bean (for example, "person")
to get global errors, or a bean property (for example, "person.name") to get
field errors (also supporting nested fields and "person.na*" mappings).
"person.*" will return all errors for the specified bean, both global
and field errors.
items.translation: 设置此标签应应用的路径。可以是 Bean（例如，"person"）以获取全局错误，也可以是 Bean 属性（例如，"person.name"）以获取字段错误（也支持嵌套字段和 "person.na*" 映射）。"person.*"将返回指定 Bean 的所有错误，包括全局错误和字段错误。
